::: {#exr-pois-score-fn}
#### Score function of a Poisson variable

Derive the score function for a single Poisson random variable $X$,
with respect to its mean parameter $\rate$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::::{#sol-pois-score-fn}

The log-likelihood of one Poisson observation is
$\loglik = x \logf{\rate} - \rate - \logf{x!}$, so:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\score
&\eqdef \deriv{\rate}\paren{x\logf{\rate} - \rate - \logf{x!}}
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= x\deriv{\rate}\logf{\rate} - \deriv{\rate}\rate - \deriv{\rate}\logf{x!}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= \frac{x}{\rate} - 1 - 0
&& \text{(derivatives of $\log \rate$, $\rate$, and a constant)}\\
&= \frac{x - \rate}{\rate}
&& \text{(common denominator)}\\
&= \scoreexpf
&& \text{($\E{X} = \Var{X} = \rate$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

::::
